articles.title: NASA’s Artemis II Successfully Lifts Off, Heads to the Moon
articles.mainIdea: NASA’s Artemis II Successfully Lifts Off, Heads to the Moon
articles.summary: Barrons.com: NASA’s Artemis II Successfully Lifts Off, Heads to the Moon. America is doing something great: Sending astronauts around the moon on a giant rocket that is taller than the Statue of Liberty. The sheer scale of space and what’s being attempted made tuning in to see NASA’s Artemis II launch Wednesday night worthwhile. The Artemis group of missions aims to return Americans to the Moon and establish a permanent presence there. Related tickers mentioned: BA, HON, LMT, RDW, RKLB.
